# Code Review

Honest caveats: it reads your diff and spawns subagents — fine on a laptop, heavier than a linter; if no spec is found it asks you, and the Spec axis is skipped when there genuinely isn't one; it skips anything your tooling already enforces. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
